conservation.help_by: Respect distance on the reef; support healthy fish stocks sharks need.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t bait, chase, or grab rays and sharks for photos.

life_info.eating: Worms, crabs, and clams found by electro-sense. Flips sand with wingbeats, then vacuums hidden snacks.
life_info.mating: Live-bearing; nursery flats can hold many young rays.
life_info.habitat: Buried in sand flats — often only eyes and spiracles show. Mostly solitary couch potatoes of the seafloor.

fun_facts: Shuffle your feet in sand — a polite knock so rays can scoot away.
The barb is defense, not a hunting spear.
